jobs.description:
Terms

• Freelance / Long-term

• Hybrid - Europe

• Occasional on-site travel

• Start: Before the end of 2026

• English-speaking

 

For a major insurance transformation programme, we are looking for an experienced freelance Product Owner with Insurance Package Implementation experience to join a greenfield Guidewire Cloud implementation within Commercial Insurance.

The client is looking to onboard Product Owners across both the PolicyCenter and Claimcenter implementation teams.

The Product Owner will take ownership of their respective product domain, working closely with business stakeholders, Business Analysts, Solution Architects, configuration developers, and other members of a distributed Agile delivery team.
Responsibilities

• Own and manage the Product Backlog for PolicyCenter or Claimcenter

• Define and communicate product vision, priorities, and roadmap

• Translate business objectives into epics, features, and user stories

• Prioritise requirements based on business value, risk, and dependencies

• Act as the key decision-maker for product-related questions and priorities

• Work closely with stakeholders to define target business processes and desired outcomes

• Collaborate with Guidewire configuration teams to ensure solutions align with business requirements

• Participate in Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Reviews, Refinements, and PI Planning

• Support testing, user acceptance activities, and release planning

• Ensure successful delivery of business value throughout the implementation lifecycle

Project context

• Greenfield Guidewire Cloud implementation

• Focus on Commercial Insurance

• PolicyCenter and Product Definition at the core of the role

• Scrum team of approximately 10 people, including 3-4 Business Analysts and configuration developers

• International/distributed project environment

• First release currently moving into User Acceptance Testing

• Next release starts with an inception phase covering requirements, solution design and user-story backlog creation

• Earlier onboarding preferred to build project and policy knowledge ahead of the next major delivery phase

• Experience as a Product Owner within insurance transformation programmes

• Previous experience with Guidewire or another core insurance platform implementation

• Strong understanding of Policy Administration and/or Claims processes

• Experience working in Agile/Scrum or SAFe environments

• Ability to engage with senior stakeholders and technology teams

• Excellent communication and prioritisation skills

What you will do
 

IMEC performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities for your career development. 
 
 

• As a member of our Fab Engineering team, you will closely work with experts of the MES and related software – commonly referred to as CIM.  

• You have an active role throughout the entire equipment lifecycle, from automation specification during procurement, to requirement gathering after commissioning, to operational improvement after production release. You make sure that operations and engineering requirements regarding CIM integration are sufficiently specified and can be implemented accordingly. To enable this implementation, you need to understand equipment behavior and communication capabilities – which frequently requires exploration and diligent testing.  

• While technical knowledge and interest is crucial to be successful in this job, you will collaborate with hardware and software engineers who either deliver details to you or must pick up conclusions made by you. Data Specialist is a pivotal role, putting equipment communication capabilities into practice.  

• Commonly known as Industry 4.0 features, in semiconductor manufacturing such equipment communication feeds applications like MES, SPC, FDC (Fault Detection and Classification), APC (Advanced Process Control), and AMHS (Automated Material Handling).  

• With this open position we are specifically looking for candidates who will work with Metrology equipment, i.e. measuring process results and product properties.  

Who you are
 
 

• You have a master’s degree in engineering, exact sciences, or equal by experience.  

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in a complex manufacturing environment, characterized by demanding processes, high product mix, and delicate materials.  

• Prior experience in or knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab.  

• You have participated in CIM projects, understanding concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS.  

• You understand measurement techniques, why different equipment is needed to measure different properties, and how measurement results can be reported.  

• You have a pro-active approach and are solution oriented. You cannot wait to roll up your sleeves and dive right into the action. You easily work independently and are an effective team player as well.  

• You thrive in a complex and demanding environment.  

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do 
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with developers of the same and adjacent software applications, Functional Analysts, and Business Analysts, to deliver a modern CIM application landscape.  

• Your primary contact will be the developer team lead, responsible for establishing our in-house development capability for the commercially sourced Equipment Integration platform, and we will assign an additional mentor during your onboarding.  

• You will follow Fab Operations to understand the different levels of automation currently implemented in our cleanrooms.  

• Your initial tasks will be configuration of existing equipment controller software modules, followed by developing clones of software modules for the same equipment type.  

• As we insource more functionality of the commercially sourced Equipment Integration platform, you will start developing equipment controller software modules for new equipment types. You will also be involved in developing custom solutions interfacing with the commercial platform.  

• You will participate in equipment model testing, both with software emulators as well as physical connection to the equipment hardware.  

Who you are 
 
 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in software development, specifically related to hardware automation, and performing Java OOP.  

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab.  

• You understand concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS.  

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are persistent.  

• Prior experience in a cooperative setup, original software supplier's engineers sharing the workload with in-house developers, as well as onsite-remote hybrid collaboration, is highly desired.  

• You feel comfortable in a complex and demanding environment.  

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

Project description

In this role, you lead complex multidisciplinary industrial engineering projects within the process industry. You are fully accountable for scope, budget, planning, quality and safety across both new installations and major modifications to existing assets.

As Project Manager, you take end-to-end responsibility for complex multidisciplinary investment projects within an industrial process setting. EOC Group is growing its hotmelt adhesives business (Exomelt), as part of a portfolio of startups and new ventures. We are looking for a hands-on, dynamic Technical Service & Development Specialist to be the technical face of hotmelts to our customers, translating their applications, processes and specifications into the right hotmelt solution, and driving technical business development on the ground.
 

You will need a thorough, practical understanding of hot melt adhesives and some formulation know-how of your own, but you won't be doing deep chemistry alone. You can lean on a team of formulation and chemistry specialists to turn your technical offers into robust products. This is a customer-facing, solution-oriented role for someone who is as comfortable on a customer's production line as in a technical discussion.

 

What will you do?

• You understand customers' applications, processes and specifications in depth, and translate them into the right hotmelt solution and a compelling technical offer.
• You drive technical business development, identifying and pursuing opportunities with new and existing customers in a hands-on, dynamic way.
• Once a solution is proposed, you support customers with in-line application advice, helping them run and troubleshoot hotmelt products on their equipment.
• You act as the technical liaison between customers and EOC's formulation and chemistry specialists, briefing the team on customer requirements and translating technical results back to customers.
• You provide training to agents and distributors who are intensively used to market our products.
• You track technical market trends and innovations in hotmelt adhesives, and bring relevant insights back into EOC's product and technology roadmap.
• You represent EOC and the Hotmelts business at industry conferences and trade shows, building EOC's technical reputation and network in the hotmelt adhesives market.

Who are you? 

• You bring a thorough understanding of hotmelt adhesives (EVA, APAO, rubber-based, polyolefin, or similar hotmelt technologies) and their end-use applications.
• You have working formulation know-how, enough to have credible technical conversations and shape a technical offer, while relying on specialists for detailed formulation work.
• You hold a chemistry degree or equivalent technical qualification (preferred).
• You are hands-on and dynamic, with a genuine drive for technical business development, comfortable owning a customer relationship from technical scoping through to in-line support.
• You communicate and build relationships strongly across customers, internal specialists, and management.
• You are willing and able to travel approximately 50% of the time, mainly shorter trips to customer sites, conferences and trade shows, not extended multi-week travel.
• You have a self-starting mindset suited to a startup environment, comfortable with ambiguity and building processes as the business scales.
You are fluent in English and German; additional European languages are an asset given EOC's customer base.

Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You are a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics
• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)
• Can work in a 2-shift system
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
Reach truck experience is a big plus but not required.

If you don't meet every requirement but have some warehouse experience and a strong work ethic, you can still apply!

 

IMPORTANT: this job is only available for people who:

• Already live in Belgium
• Have a valid Belgian address
• Have legal permission to work in Belgium
Housing, relocation and visa sponsorship are not available for this position.
